_about: Which repo folder each Obsidian vault is, so docs_gate.py can check an obsidian:// link against the file it opens. A link names its vault by name or id (vault=) or by folder (path=); each is matched here. The id and path come from ~/Library/Application Support/obsidian/obsidian.json on Omar's machine (2026-09-27). The link opens the main checkout; the gate checks this checkout, so a link is judged against the tree it ships with.
